ocr.notes: Allen paragraph reads correctly apart from $10,009

summary.suggested: The Missouri Republican carried a San Francisco dispatch that Tom Allen declined Joe Coburn's challenge to fight until after his contest with Jim Mace the next July.

metadata.notes: Masthead: The Missouri Republican, St. Louis, January 22, 1870. Dispatch dated San Francisco, Jan. 21.

facts.fact: Allen declined Joe Coburn's challenge to fight for $500 [likely $5,000] or $10,000 until after his contest with Jem Mace, then expected in July 1870

notes: Image prints $500; the Democrat version (384) prints $5000. Same item as 384.
